correctness.rationale: Squarefreeness follows from the exact integral quintic discriminant reduced mod 3. The explicit 4×4 Cartier–Manin matrix has determinant a²(b−1)², kernel dimension 0 or 2, and stable Frobenius rank 4/2/0. The isolated rank-zero case is the separable degree-5 quotient of a maximal Hermitian curve, implying supersingularity; the p-rank-2 residual slopes follow polarization and slope-denominator constraints. Three forbidden-parameter functions collide only at a=0,±1 and yield the stated all-q mass formulas. A standalone finite-field gcd/rank/point checker independently verified q=3,9,27,81, with 154 points at q=81. Proof remains independent of finite tests.
